SPEC:
Design sheet of 6 WORLD EVENT medallions for the world map screen of a dark fantasy samurai RPG, same UI kit as the attached mockup (Image 1): each a round medallion in a copper-gold double ring with tiny diamond studs, dark lacquer centre with one glowing emblem, and a small coloured halo glow. 1. "War" - crimson crossed spears over a cracked shield, crimson glow.
2. "Rift" - a jagged glowing pink-violet crack in the sky with a burning eye-ring above it (the Eye of the Rift flaring, mana tide), magenta glow.
3. "Wild Hunt" - two moons (silver and lilac) overlapping inside a pale ring, with a fey antlered spirit silhouette, lilac glow.
4. "Dragon" - a coiled awakening dragon head breathing a thin flame, orange-gold glow.
5. "Silent Golems" - a cracked stone golem mask with dead runes, cold teal glow.
6. "Peace" - a white lotus on calm water with a soft jade glow.
Same size and line weight for all emblems, iconic and readable at 64 px, premium game icon quality.
Input images: Image 1: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: landscape 3:2.
